name.full: Pollyn - polls, suggestions & raffles for your org

description.short: Get everyone's vote: quick polls, suggestions, live results and raffles.
description.full: Pollyn makes it easy to get everyone's vote in your organization, from the lunch order to serious decisions and fun events. Build a poll step by step with single or multiple choice, rating and free-text questions, add images or videos for context, and let voters suggest their own options. Voters sign in with their work account (Teams single sign-on), answer one question at a time on any device, and can pick up where they left off. Choose whether a poll is exclusive to your organization or open to anyone with the link, and decide who sees results, vote counts and voter names. When it is time to celebrate, run a spinner wheel, raffle draw or entry-count board with fair, server-side random draws.
